_comment: Hand-written input to scripts/build_panel.py. 'entries' are named PDB entries with the features we claim for them (each claim is verified from the file by the script; an unverified claim fails the build). 'disease_proteins' are UniProt accessions: the script picks the structure by the rule in README.md unless 'entry' pins one that tasks already use. 'alphafold' are UniProt accessions whose AlphaFold DB model joins the panel.

entries.why: Sperm-whale oxymyoglobin at 1.0 A: heme with bound O2, alternate conformations.
Cellular retinoic-acid-binding protein II with retinoic acid: small beta-barrel, one buried ligand.
Green fluorescent protein: beta-barrel with the chromophore as a modified residue inside the chain.
Human oxyhaemoglobin: one alpha-beta pair deposited, tetramer is the biological assembly.
HIV-1 protease dimer with a cyclic-urea inhibitor at the dimer interface.
Hen egg-white lysozyme: the textbook small enzyme, four disulfides.
Sperm-whale myoglobin, the first protein structure: all-alpha, heme.
p53 core domain on DNA: three protein chains whose author chain ids differ from the label chain ids, zinc site, the main cancer-variant protein.
Phosphodiesterase 5 catalytic domain with sildenafil: a drug in its target, zinc and magnesium.
Human deoxyhaemoglobin: full alpha2-beta2 tetramer deposited, four hemes.
PCSK9: multi-domain secreted protease with a prodomain chain.
Bovine trypsin with benzamidine: chymotrypsinogen numbering with insertion codes, so author and label residue numbers differ.
Pig insulin: two A-B pairs deposited, zinc hexamer is the assembly; inter-chain disulfides.
Human CFTR by cryo-EM: a large membrane transporter, the cystic-fibrosis protein.
Hen egg-white lysozyme (orthorhombic form): second copy of a familiar fold in another entry.
The Dickerson B-DNA dodecamer: DNA only, two chains.
Bovine rhodopsin: the first GPCR structure, retinal, two chains.
Streptavidin with biotin: one chain deposited, tetramer is the assembly.
Ubiquitin at 1.8 A: a 76-residue single chain with no ligands, the plain baseline.
Human A2A adenosine receptor (T4-lysozyme fusion) with antagonist ZM241385: a drug-target GPCR with lipids.
HIV-1 gp120 with antibody VRC01: antibody-antigen complex with many N-glycans.
SARS-CoV-2 spike trimer by cryo-EM: heavily glycosylated; over the size limit, kept because a task already uses it.
Crambin: 46 residues, three disulfides, the smallest well-ordered protein in the panel.
Ribonuclease A at 1.4 A: alpha+beta fold, four disulfides.
Trp-cage miniprotein by NMR: 20 residues, 38 models (only the first is tabled).
Ubiquitin by NMR: the multi-model partner of 1UBQ.
Adenylate kinase with the bisubstrate inhibitor AP5A: two copies, a large nucleotide ligand.
Protein kinase A with ATP, manganese and an inhibitor peptide: phosphorylated residues, two protein chains.
E. coli dihydrofolate reductase with folate and NADP+: two different ligands in one site.
HIV-1 protease with indinavir: second protease-drug complex, different inhibitor class from 1HVR.
Abl kinase domain with imatinib: a kinase-drug complex, two copies.
Oestrogen receptor alpha ligand-binding domain with 4-hydroxytamoxifen: a nuclear receptor with its antagonist.
Trypsin with its protein inhibitor BPTI: protein-protein complex, chymotrypsinogen numbering.
Horse cytochrome c: heme covalently attached to two cysteines.
Cytochrome P450cam with camphor: heme plus a substrate, cysteine-ligated iron.
Rubredoxin at 1.1 A: one iron held by four cysteines, 53 residues.
Plastocyanin at 1.33 A: a copper site in a small beta-sandwich.
Intact IgG2a antibody: four chains, many disulfides, Fc glycans.
Human IgG1 Fc fragment: a biantennary N-glycan on each chain.
Galectin-3 carbohydrate-recognition domain with N-acetyllactosamine: a bound disaccharide (branched entity that is not a glycosylation).
KcsA potassium channel with a Fab: one channel subunit deposited, tetramer on a crystal axis; K+ ions in the selectivity filter.
OmpF porin: a membrane beta-barrel, one chain deposited, trimer is the assembly.
Bacteriorhodopsin at 1.55 A: seven helices, retinal covalently bound to a lysine, lipids.
Yeast phenylalanine tRNA at 1.93 A: RNA only, modified bases, magnesium.
Adenine riboswitch with adenine: RNA binding a small ligand.
Human telomeric G-quadruplex: non-duplex DNA with potassium ions on the axis.
Zif268 zinc fingers on DNA at 1.6 A: three zinc sites, protein-DNA.
Lambda repressor on operator DNA: a helix-turn-helix dimer on DNA.
Nucleosome core particle: eight histone chains and 146 bp of DNA, the largest multi-chain entry under the size limit.
Human haemoglobin by cryo-EM: the same protein as 2HHB by another method.
Mouse apoferritin by cryo-EM at 1.22 A: atomic-resolution cryo-EM; one chain deposited, the 24-mer is the assembly.

disease_proteins.disease: hyperlipoproteinaemia type III; Alzheimer disease risk

alphafold.why: AlphaFold model of full-length p53: used by an existing task; UniProt numbering by construction, long low-confidence regions.
AlphaFold model of haemoglobin beta: same protein as 2HHB chain B but numbered as UniProt, so the same variant sits at a different residue number.
